question: After a new full-time employee completes 30 days of employment, when does benefit coverage generally begin?
expected_points: Coverage generally begins on the first day of the calendar month after 30 calendar days of employment are completed.
If day 30 is the first day of a month, coverage begins on the first day of the following month.
The enrollment system displays the employee's actual coverage date.
notes: Development-only direct fact used to observe answerable-score behavior.

question: What service requirement and employee-contribution condition apply to paid parental leave and continued active benefits?
expected_points: Paid parental leave eligibility requires 12 completed months of employment as of the leave start date.
Approved paid parental leave provides up to 12 weeks.
Active benefits continue on the same terms as for an actively working employee during the paid leave.
The employee must continue any required employee contributions.
notes: Development-only cross-document item used to observe multi-source retrieval scores.

question: May I work from a different state for six weeks while staying with family?
expected_points: Working from a different state for more than 30 calendar days requires advance written approval from People Operations and the employee's manager.
Remote-work eligibility also depends on job duties, team coverage, data restrictions, performance, and a safe and secure workspace.
Personal travel does not make lodging, meals, transportation, or connectivity reimbursable.
notes: Development-only qualified request with a stated duration and an approval condition.
